docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The Pāli poem Dāṭhāvaṃsa on the Buddha’s tooth relic and its journey to Ceylon, edited and translated by Sir Mutu Coomāra Swāmy (London, 1874). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Robarts Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Dathávansa; or, The history of the tooth-relic of Gotama Buddha · Mutu Kumara Svami, 1834-1879, tr. [and] ed · 1874, 108 scanned pages. Published 1874; Mutu Coomára Swámy died 1879; the text is medieval; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
